subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is the exact first-frame composition of [Shot 1], showing the protagonist riding through the surveillance city with her companion robot, cyber motorcycle, giant red sun, concrete megastructures, stacked containers, cameras, and digital-eye screens.
<Subject 1> is the same young dark-skinned female protagonist defined by <Picture 2> and <Picture 1>, preserving her facial identity, asymmetrical white dreadlocks, shaved sides, cyan-and-magenta face markings, magenta scarf, ivory technical outfit, tan cargo trousers, athletic build, and single mechanical arm.
<Subject 2> is the same compact flying companion robot defined by <Picture 3> and <Picture 1>, preserving its rounded off-white body, magenta armor panels, single cyan optical eye, two ducted-fan pods, and two small manipulator arms.
<Subject 3> is the same rugged cyber motorcycle defined primarily by <Picture 4> and secondarily by <Picture 1>. <Picture 4> has the highest priority for its wheelbase, tires, frame, pink windscreen, ivory-and-magenta armor, cyan lamps and wheel accents, engine, seat, and dual exhaust structure. Keep the existing side-number panel stable and visually clean; add exact “079” lettering in post rather than generating altered digits.
<Subject 4> is the elevated surveillance-city environment defined by <Picture 5> and <Picture 1>, preserving the narrow central road, stacked shipping containers, exposed-concrete cores, maintenance pipes, white cameras, repeated digital-eye screens, clouds below the city, and the giant calm red sun.

summary:
[keyframe completion + reference generation] The target is a 15-second, 16:9 cinematic 3D animated action sequence beginning exactly from <Picture 1>. <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> race through <Subject 4> on <Subject 3>, briefly disrupt the surveillance network, leap across a cloud-filled gap, and disappear into a narrow concrete passage while one digital eye reactivates.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] first frame): fully_preserved - the opening composition, subject placement, lighting direction, giant red sun, road perspective, and surveillance-city atmosphere are retained at 0.00 seconds.
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the same face, skin tone, hairstyle, markings, costume, body proportions, and mechanical-arm side remain consistent.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the same robot body, single eye, two fan pods, two small arms, colors, and compact scale remain consistent.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - one unchanged motorcycle is used throughout, with <Picture 4> taking priority over all other references for appearance and structure.
<Subject 4> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the same construction system, red sun, high-altitude clouds, surveillance devices, color palette, and bright oppressive daylight remain continuous.

detailed_description:
The target video uses premium stylized cinematic 3D animation with physically based materials, restrained graphic edge treatment, bright permanent daylight, warm coral highlights, cool cyan sky fill, deep neutral shadows, and thin high-altitude haze. The mood is visually seductive but institutionally oppressive.

[Shot 1] The video begins exactly from <Picture 1>. A low front three-quarter tracking shot moves backward at fast speed ahead of <Subject 3> as <Subject 1> rides directly toward the camera through <Subject 4>. She lowers her chest over the fuel tank, keeps both hands naturally locked around the handlebars, and looks straight ahead with a focused, defiant expression. Her white dreadlocks and magenta scarf stream backward under the airflow while her mechanical arm remains anatomically stable. <Subject 2> flies close to her right-rear side, matching her speed with small corrective movements from its two ducted fans. During the first four seconds, identical white cameras rotate toward her in a sequential wave. Digital-eye screens illuminate one after another from foreground to background, their irises tightening as if acquiring a target. The camera remains smooth and close while background containers streak with restrained motion blur.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.500, a narrow horizontal glitch tear creates a hard cut to a lateral tracking shot. <Subject 2> darts upward without changing its design or scale and emits one short, narrow cyan interference pulse along the screen array. The pulse affects only the surveillance displays and camera lenses; it does not distort the environment or characters. The repeated eyes break into controlled horizontal static and several cameras freeze mid-turn. <Subject 1> twists the throttle, shifts her weight forward, and accelerates <Subject 3> toward the rising ramp. The suspension compresses over the uneven road, the rear tire grips the surface, and the same wheels, armor, frame and windscreen remain rigid and correctly connected. The camera whip-pans right with large amplitude at fast speed, then locks beside the motorcycle as it climbs the ramp.

[Shot 3] At 00:09.500, the shot cuts to a wide side view as <Subject 3> launches from the edge into open air above the clouds. The giant red sun remains calm and almost motionless behind <Subject 1>, forming a clear silhouette without swallowing her facial and costume identity. <Subject 2> follows the same flight arc slightly above and behind the motorcycle. The camera tracks them at fast speed with large amplitude while the city towers slide across the background. The motorcycle stays structurally rigid in flight; both wheels remain aligned, and no parts detach or transform. At approximately 00:12.600, the motorcycle lands hard on the opposite platform, suspension compressing once before recovering. <Subject 1> steadies the bike and races into a narrow concrete passage. At 00:14.300, the camera performs a sudden short zoom toward one foreground eye screen. Its static clears, the iris reopens, and a final horizontal glitch tear freezes the last frame at 00:15.000.

Across all shots, keep the same woman, the same mechanical-arm side, the same robot and the same motorcycle. Do not mirror identities, change colors, alter vehicle type, duplicate the robot, fuse subjects, create extra limbs, deform hands, disconnect wheels, float components, introduce random text, generate unstable digits, add excessive neon, use cheap blue bloom, or shift into nighttime cyberpunk imagery.

overall_soundscape:
Strong high-altitude wind continues throughout, layered with the motorcycle’s rising engine tone, tire friction, suspension impacts, the robot’s compact ducted-fan whine, and synchronized camera-servo rotations. A short electrical interference crackle accompanies the cyan pulse and screen failure, followed by a heavy landing impact, a brief tire skid, and one clean electronic activation tone when the final eye reopens.

non_diegetic_music:
A fast 150-BPM hybrid electronic breakbeat with tight industrial percussion, low distorted synth pulses, and sparse metallic impacts. The rhythm briefly drops out during the airborne jump, returns with one heavy bass hit on landing, and ends with an abrupt digital cutoff at the final glitch.
